summary:
Lando Norris delivered a lap of the Gods to claim pole position for the first Spanish Grand Prix held at the Madring, as Max Verstappen responded to a "BS" claim that there is not enough space to have built an overtaking spot.

F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli was the favourite for pole going into qualifying in Madrid and would have claimed it, had Norris not gone 0.011s faster with an extraordinary lap. The Ferrari duo had to settle for fourth and fifth, with George Russell completing the top six.
